posts.excerptEnglish: [Xuezhongfei apologizes to Hou Minghao for unauthorized ticket sales. The unauthorized sale of Hou Minghao's tickets violates the spirit of the contract.] On November 15, @Hou Minghao Studio issued a statement: We collaborated with Xuezhongfei @Xuezhongfei (hereinafter referred to as the "Brand") for the artist's in-person event on November 21, 2026. The contract prohibits the Brand from distributing event tickets for any form of payment. Recently, we discovered that the brand publicly sold seats for this in-person event without obtaining our prior consent. We were completely unaware of this action beforehand, and it has misled the public and harmed the interests of fans. We strongly condemn this behavior. We hereby officially notify the brand to immediately cease all ticket and seat sales, remove all related promotional materials, issue refunds to all ticket purchasers, and submit a written explanation and remedial plan to us. If the brand refuses to rectify the situation, we will use all legal means to protect our legitimate rights and interests. posts.excerptEnglish: Xuezhongfei apologizes to Hou Minghao [Hou Minghao Studio condemns the brand for selling tickets in violation of regulations] Xuezhongfei officially announced Hou Minghao as its brand ambassador last month. On November 15, @Hou Minghao Studio issued a statement: We have partnered with Xuezhongfei @Xuezhongfei (hereinafter referred to as the "Brand") for the artist's in-person event on November 21, 2026. The contract prohibits the Brand from distributing event admission tickets in any form for compensation. Recently, we discovered that the brand publicly sold seats for this in-person event without obtaining our prior consent. We were completely unaware of this action beforehand, and it has misled the public and harmed the interests of fans. We strongly condemn this behavior. We hereby officially notify the brand to immediately cease all ticket and seat sales, remove all related promotional materials, issue refunds to all ticket purchasers, and submit a written explanation and remedial plan to us. posts.excerptEnglish: Formal Statement We are collaborating with Xuezhongfei @Xuezhongfei (hereinafter referred to as the "Brand") for the artist's in-person event on November 21, 2026. The contract explicitly prohibits the Brand from distributing event admission tickets in any form for a fee. Recently, we discovered that the Brand publicly sold seats for this in-person event without obtaining our prior consent. We were completely unaware of this action beforehand, and it has misled the public and harmed the interests of fans. We strongly condemn this behavior. We hereby formally notify the Brand to immediately cease all ticket and seat sales, remove all related promotional materials, issue refunds to all ticket purchasers, and submit a written explanation and remedial plan to us. If the Brand refuses to rectify the situation, we will use all legal means to protect our lawful rights and interests. At the same time, we would like to remind all fans to protect their personal property and be wary of scams. Hou Minghao Studio November 15, 2026
